# Code of Conduct

We expect contributors and maintainers to communicate respectfully, discuss technical disagreements with evidence, and avoid harassment, threats, discrimination, or disclosure of private information.

Report conduct concerns privately through the maintainer contact listed in the repository security/contact settings. Maintainers may edit or remove contributions, restrict participation, or ban participants when necessary to protect the community.

Enforcement decisions should be documented privately, applied consistently, and disclose only what is necessary.
